playbook.title: Order playbook — recall first, discover only for gaps
playbook.principle: The agent proposes; the gateway checks and decides. Recall the kitchen's own memory before searching.

steps.name: Receive
steps.does: Log the request and identify buyer, site and agent.

guards.text: The agent must be registered to the buyer.
The buyer must have a valid signed spending limit (Intent Mandate). Otherwise stop.

steps.name: Understand
steps.does: Extract the Order Brief (what, how much, when, where, constraints, context). Mark each fact found, assumed or missing.

guards.text: If date, quantity or site is missing, ask ONE question card. Assumptions are shown, never hidden.

steps.name: Recall first
steps.does: Search the buyer's own memory in a fixed order and build the idea from there.

guards.text: Discover tools stay locked until recall has run.
Lines matched with high confidence go straight to Plan; only gaps go to Discover.

steps.name: Discover only for gaps
steps.does: For the gaps only, map the need to a product group, search the Valio Aimo assortment and get signed offers.

guards.text: Locked when recall left no gaps.
If no offer meets the hard constraints (allergens, diet), return a safe alternative or a "Can't do this".

steps.name: Plan
steps.does: Build the basket. Quantity = guests × learned use + buffer − leftovers, whole packs with least waste, delivery day by shelf life, at most 3 alternatives where there is a real choice.

guards.text: Every line traces to recall or discovery and carries a plain "why".

steps.name: Check
steps.does: The gateway runs the trust checks (signed, fresh offers) and the spending, allergen and delivery rules.

guards.text: The decision is computed by the gateway; the agent cannot change it.

steps.name: Present
steps.does: Turn the result into cards the chef understands.

guards.text: No banned words; at most 3 numbers and 3 options per card; one main action.

steps.name: Act
steps.does: Place the order, or send the OK request to the right person.

guards.text: Only after Check, and only what Check allowed (auto / tell me, or after the OK).
Prices are locked to the signed offers; an expired or changed offer stops the order.

steps.name: Follow up and learn
steps.does: Delivery updates, "How did it go?" after the event, outcome labels and tips. Feeds Recall next time.

buyerId.description: Customer account; defaults to the credential's own buyer.

agentId.description: Set by the gateway from the credential.

channel.description: Set by the gateway: how the agent connects.

text.description: The request in the chef's own words (English or Finnish).

answer.description: The answer to the one question ask_user returned.

field.description: The field the question asked for: when, howMuch or where.

examples.text: I need 1,000 litres of lactose-free milk by Monday.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'oat drink'.

need.description: A gap from recall; used as the query when query is empty.

excludeAllergens.description: Allergens the product must not contain.

diet.description: Diet claims the product must have, e.g. vegan.

productId.description: GTIN or Valio Aimo product id from search_products.

choices.description: lineId -> productId, for a line with pendingChoices.

useAlternative.description: lineId whose safe alternative (from cantDo) to use.

acceptSuggestion.description: suggestionId from get_suggestions (Valio Aimo seller) to add; re-plans and re-checks.

cards.description: Optional own wording; must pass the same plain-language lint.

offerIds.description: Exactly the offer ids of the checked basket (plan_basket.offers).
